name: Pre-College Programs (paid tracks)
what_you_do: Live on or commute to the CMU campus for 3 to 6 weeks. Study architecture, art, design, drama or music. Also study computational biology or writing. You can also study culture. Pick the National High School Game Academy or college summer courses.
grades: 10th or 11th grade at time of application
who_can_apply: High school students at least 16 years old by June 26, 2027 who are in 10th or 11th grade when they apply.
pay_detail: 2026 prices ran from about $5,999 (3-week music, commuter) to $14,688 (summer session, residential, 2 courses), plus a $75 application fee and an $800 enrollment deposit. 2027 prices are posted in November 2026. Full scholarships for students with financial need.
duration: 3 to 6 weeks depending on the program (summer 2027 starts June 26)
deadline_text: Scholarship application deadline February 1, 2027 (decisions April 1, 2027). Basic application deadline March 1, 2027 (rolling decisions).
how_to_apply: Apply online through the CMU Pre-College application portal. The scholarship option is only considered under the February 1, 2027 deadline.
notes: Status is unconfirmed only because the application opening date is not posted; the 2027 deadlines are confirmed on the program pages (the apply portal could not be read). Expensive; shown so families know the cost and the scholarship route. The three fully funded programs (AI Scholars, CS Scholars, SAMS) cost nothing. Check the cost page again in November 2026 for 2027 prices.
